title: Reuben, Gad and Manasseh Build an Altar by the Jordan
description: The two and a half tribes of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh build a large altar by the Jordan on their way home to Gilead. The other tribes gather at Shiloh to go to war but first send the priest Phinehas and ten leaders to confront them. The tribes explain that the altar is not for sacrifices but as a witness to their share in the Lord. Phinehas and the assembly accept the explanation, and the altar is named "Witness".
